title: 'Abasa 80:9-16 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Abasa 80:9-16 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 14. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ (٩) فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ (١٠) كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ (١١) فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ (١٢) فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ (١٣) مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ (١٤) بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ (١٥) كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ (١٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
So whoever wills may remember it.

questions.q: Chunk and link 'Abasa 80:9-16 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 80:9-16 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 80:9-16 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write three ways you show respect to the mushaf at home.
questions.a: Wudu before touching it; keep it on a shelf or stand; never put it on the floor.

questions.q: Recite 80:1 to 16, then find the two idgham with ghunnah in 80:13 to 14.
80:13 to 16 describe the Qur'an as being in ...
options: honoured, purified pages held by noble scribes
questions.a: A) honoured, purified pages held by noble scribes. 80:13 to 16: honoured pages, exalted and purified, by the hands of scribes, noble and dutiful.

questions.q: Think again: The Qur'an is written on 'honoured pages, exalted and purified, by the hands of scribes' (80:13 to 15). What does that tell you about how to treat a mushaf?
questions.a: With great respect: clean hands, a clean place, never left on the floor; it is Allah's honoured word.
